## Data Cleaning

```{r Data Cleaning, error=F, warning=F}
# Read in permit locations (CSV to dataframe)
# NOTE: set the working directory to a local folder with the "clean1625_Wilmington.csv" with your personal drive (due to large file size with 75245 observations and 106 variable attributes)
clean_orm_Wilmington <- read.csv("./clean1625_Wilmington.csv")

clean_orm_Wilmington$action_type <- as.factor(clean_orm_Wilmington$action_type)

# Display the structure of the dataframe
str(clean_orm_Wilmington)
class(clean_orm_Wilmington$action_type)

# Convert the dataframe to an sf dataframe.
sum(is.na(clean_orm_Wilmington$proj_longitude))
sum(is.na(clean_orm_Wilmington$proj_latitude))

Wilmington_sf <- clean_orm_Wilmington %>%
  filter(!is.na(proj_longitude),
         !is.na(proj_latitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("proj_longitude", "proj_latitude"),
    crs = 4269
  )

# Display the structure
str(Wilmington_sf)

Wilmington_sf_RIA_Period <- Wilmington_sf %>%
  mutate(
    federally_complete_date = as.Date(
      federally_complete_date,
      format = "%d-%b-%y"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(federally_complete_date),
    federally_complete_date >= as.Date("2021-01-01")
  )

# NOTE: NC County Boundary found under repository "Data" folder
NC <- vect("NC_County_Boundary/County_Boundary.shp")
NC_new <- project(NC, crs(Wilmington_sf))
NC_new <- st_as_sf(NC_new)
```

## Spatial Analysis

```{r Plotting Data, error=F, warning=F}
## Plot permits by action type
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = NC_new,
    fill = "blue",
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.75,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = Wilmington_sf_RIA_Period,
    aes(color = action_type),
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CWA Section 404 Permit Locations by Action Type in North Carolina from the Last RIA Period (1/4/2021-9/30/2025)",
    subtitle = "Created by Elizabeth Miles-Flynn",
    color = "Action Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

## Plot auth_fill_acres by size
Wilmington_sf_RIA_Period_fill <- Wilmington_sf_RIA_Period %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(auth_fill_acres),
    auth_fill_acres > 0
  )

# Convert both layers to WGS84
Wilmington_sf_leaflet <- st_transform(
  Wilmington_sf_RIA_Period_fill,
  4326
)

NC_leaflet <- st_transform(
  NC_new,
  4326
)

# Create palette
pal <- colorBin(
  palette = "YlOrRd",
  domain = Wilmington_sf_leaflet$auth_fill_acres,
  bins = c(
    0,
    0.1,
    0.5,
    1,
    2,
    5,
    10,
    25,
    50,
    100,
    200
  ),
  pretty = FALSE
)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = NC_leaflet,
    fillColor = "blue",
    fillOpacity = 0.3,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = Wilmington_sf_leaflet,
    radius = 1,
    fillColor = ~pal(auth_fill_acres),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    stroke = FALSE,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Authorized Fill Acres:</b> ",
      auth_fill_acres
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = Wilmington_sf_leaflet$auth_fill_acres,
    title = "Authorized Fill Acres"
  )


## Plot auth_fill_acres by radius size
pal2 <- colorBin(
  palette = "YlOrBr",
  domain = Wilmington_sf_leaflet$auth_fill_acres,
  bins = c(
    0, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 200
  ),
  pretty = FALSE
)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

  addPolygons(
    data = NC_leaflet,
    fillColor = "blue",
    fillOpacity = 0.3,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1
  ) %>%

  addCircleMarkers(
    data = Wilmington_sf_leaflet,

    # Size represents acreage
    radius = ~pmax(2, sqrt(auth_fill_acres)),

    # Color represents acreage bins
    fillColor = ~pal2(auth_fill_acres),
    color = ~pal2(auth_fill_acres),

    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    weight = 1,

    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Authorized Fill Acres:</b> ", round(auth_fill_acres, 2),
      "<br><b>Action Type:</b> ", action_type,
      "<br><b>Date:</b> ", federally_complete_date
    )
  ) %>%
  
addLegend(
  position = "bottomright",
  pal = pal2,
  values = Wilmington_sf_leaflet$auth_fill_acres,
  title = "Authorized Fill Acres"
)
